raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "be the chef at"
  role subject "Emma"
  role object "the Old Mill Hall"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "be the chef at"
  role subject "Luminița"
  role object "the Botanical Garden in Arad"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "repair"
  role subject "Megan"
  role object "the school bus"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "repair"
  role subject "Mirela"
  role object "the warehouse forklift"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "repair"
  role subject "Hao"
  role object "the fire engine"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s6 stated
  relation "repair"
  role subject "Otilia Stan"
  role object "the delivery van"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s7 stated
  relation "plant"
  role subject "Bohdan"
  role object "peppers"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s8 stated
  relation "plant"
  role subject "Yan Wang"
  role object "strawberries"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s9 stated
  relation "grow"
  role subject "Mr Barbu"
  role object "apple trees"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@s10 stated
  relation "cook at"
  role subject "Ananya"
  role object "the Community Centre on Elm Street"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s11 stated
  relation "rent"
  role subject "Ms Sharma"
  role object "the vineyard near Sibiu"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s12 stated
  relation "rent"
  role subject "Natalia"
  role object "the bakery on the corner"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@q query
  mode count
  select ?t
  where match
    relation "plant"
    role subject "Mr Popescu"
    role object "sunflowers"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  mode count
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "sing in"
    role subject ?x
    role object "the Madrigal choir"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q3 query
  mode count
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "cook at"
    role subject ?x
    role object "the Izmir Philharmonic"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q4 query
  where match
    relation "rent"
    role subject "Dimitra"
    role object "the old sailing boat"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q5 query
  select ?t
  measure duration
  where match
    relation "repair"
    role subject "Petronela"
    role object "the hospital ambulance"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q6 query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "rent"
      role subject ?x
      role object "the holiday cottage in Bran"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  except ?x "Ethan"
